plan.extraRoomOnTopOf: Extra room on top of your plan, billed with it.
plan.addOnsCanTBe: Add-ons can't be bought in the app.
plan.youLlPayOnXendit: You'll pay on Xendit's secure page: GCash, Maya, a card, QR Ph or over the counter. Then you come back here.
plan.testModeXenditSTest: Test mode: Xendit's test page lets you finish the payment without paying anything real.
plan.thisIsASamplePayment: This is a sample payment: nothing is charged, and it goes through without paying.
plan.startFreeWithOneHousehold: Start free with one household. The manager pays; kasambahay never do, and every plan keeps their rest, leave and record theirs.
plan.lowerThanYourPlanCancel: Lower than your plan: cancel first.
plan.paysWhatSOwedAnd: Pays what's owed and keeps everything working.
plan.waitingForXenditToConfirm: Waiting for Xendit to confirm your last payment. Changes open again once it's in.
plan.seeHowTheAppLooks: See how the app looks on another payment status. Only this tab changes, until it's reloaded.
plan.planChangesArenTAvailable: Plan changes aren't available in the app.
plan.addMoreOrBigger: Add more with an add-on, or choose a bigger plan.
plan.moveUpAnyTime: You can move up any time. To move to a lower plan, cancel this one: you keep it until {date}.
plan.startsOncePaid: The new plan starts once it's paid.
plan.payOnXendit: You pay on Xendit's secure page.
plan.paymentsSample: Payments here are a sample: nothing is charged.
plan.dropsPaid: This drops {items} you've paid for this period. It isn't refunded.
plan.overAfterChange: You'd have more than this plan allows ({items}). You'll choose which stay active; for the rest, new tasks and changes pause. Nothing is deleted, and every kasambahay keeps her own record, leave and rest days.
plan.keepUntil: You keep everything on {plan} until {date}. Then you're on Free, and you can choose any plan. Changed your mind before then? Keep it from Your plan.
plan.noPaymentsPreview: No payments in this preview yet.
plan.previewNotLive: A preview: billing isn't live yet, so nothing here charges you.
plan.testModeNote: Test mode: payments go through Xendit's test page, so nothing real is charged.
plan.coversEveryHousehold: Your plan covers every household you own.
plan.belongsToPrimary: This household's plan belongs to its primary manager.
plan.acrossHouseholds: Across every household you own. A kasambahay working in two of them counts once.
plan.countsThisHousehold: Kasambahay counts this household for now; across all your households once billing is live.
plan.featuresOnPlan: {onPlan} of {total} features are on your plan.
plan.yourPlanWillAllowIf: Your plan will allow {value}. If you have more than that, you'll choose which stay active. It takes effect now. No refund for the period that's running.
plan.byReferenceASampleNothing: {value} by {name}, reference {span}. A sample: nothing was charged.
plan.restrictedNoAdd: Your plan's payment is overdue, so nothing new can be added until it's paid.
plan.pickedGone: Something picked isn't there any more. Pick again.
plan.keepOneHousehold: Keep at least one household active.
plan.afterThisAllows: After this, your plan allows {households} and {kasambahay}.
plan.allowsRest: {plan} allows {households} and {kasambahay}. For the rest, new tasks and schedule changes pause; nothing is deleted, and you can change this any time. A kasambahay not chosen keeps her own app: her record, leave and rest days.
plan.youveChosen_one: You've chosen {count} household and {kasambahay} kasambahay to stay active.
plan.youveChosen_other: You've chosen {count} households and {kasambahay} kasambahay to stay active.
plan.addedChargedNow: Added ones are charged now for the period that's running, then billed with your plan.
plan.includedFromSavedStays: It's included from {plan}. Anything saved before stays.
plan.rightsNote: {rights}. A kasambahay's weekly rest day and yearly leave are hers by law (RA 10361), and her record is hers to keep.
plan.needMoreRoom: Need a little more room on Normal or Premium? Add {addons} to your plan any time. Staff pay & HR is switched off for now while it's brought in line with the law.
